articles.summary: AptarGroup, Inc. (NYSE: ATR), a global leader in drug delivery, dosing and protection technologies, and consumer product dispensing, today announced the appointment of Olivier de Saignes as President of Aptar Beauty and a member of Aptar’s Executive Committee, effective January 1, 2027. Olivier de Saignes has served as President, Aptar Beauty, Northeast Asia and Southeast Asia, since 2022. During his tenure, he has delivered strong top- and bottom-line growth while strengthening Aptar’s position in one of the world’s most dynamic beauty markets. He has built strong relationships with fast beauty and indie brands, advanced Aptar’s joint venture operations, and led initiatives to optimize costs and strengthen the region’s industrial capabilities. “Olivier de Saignes is a proven leader with more than two decades of experience in the beauty industry and a strong track record across operations, innovation, commercial leadership and PL management.
